name: any file whose name ends in goal-threads.md rebuilds the goal tree
expect: ⛔ another file named goal-threads.md elsewhere does not

name: every generator gets the default timeout instead of the one asked for
expect: each generator gets its OWN timeout

name: a failed generator makes the HOOK exit non-zero
edits: if a.all and any(r["rc"] != 0 for r in results):
if any(r["rc"] != 0 for r in results):
expect: ⛔ --hook exits 0 even when every generator failed, and the report reaches stdout

name: a hook that cannot run at all exits non-zero
expect: ⛔ --hook that cannot run at all still exits 0, and SAYS the pages may be stale

name: a generator that crashed (negative exit) is not named as stale
edits: bad = [r for r in results if r["rc"] != 0]
bad = [r for r in results if r["rc"] > 0]
expect: ⛔ every failure is NAMED with its exit code, and says the page is stale

name: --all exits 0 when a page did not rebuild
edits:
if a.all and any(r["rc"] != 0 for r in results):
            return 1

if a.all and any(r["rc"] != 0 for r in results):
            return 0
expect: --all exits 1 when a page did not rebuild (it is a command, not a hook)

name: an unrelated command still prints a rebuild report
expect: --hook on an unrelated command is silent and launches nothing

name: X3: the merge is matched by a regex over the raw text, so quoted text fires it
edits: return any(c[:3] == ["gh", "pr", "merge"] for c in commands(cmd))
expect: ⛔ X3: a QUOTED merge is text, not a command

name: X3: `gh pr merge-base` matches because the regex boundary accepts a hyphen
expect: ⛔ X3: `gh pr merge-base` is not `gh pr merge`

name: X3: separators do not split commands, so `cd x && gh pr merge` is one argv
edits:
if t and set(t) <= set(SEPARATORS):
            out.append([])
expect: X3: a compound `cd x && gh pr merge 5` IS a merge

name: X3: a newline is whitespace, so a merge on the second line is not seen
expect: X3: after a pipe, a semicolon or a newline it is still a merge

name: X3: a leading NAME=value assignment is taken as the command name (re-anchored on the Y5 rewrite)
expect: X3: a leading NAME=value assignment is not the command name

name: Y5: compound-syntax words are taken as the command name, so `then gh pr merge` is missed
expect: Y5: a merge inside `if … then … fi` is seen

name: Y5: POSIX tokenizing drops the quotes, so a quoted `;` splits the command
expect: ⛔ Y5: a QUOTED separator is text, so `echo ";" gh pr merge` is one echo

name: Y5: here-document bodies are read as commands
expect: ⛔ Y5: a here-document BODY is data, never a command

name: Y5: a here-document never ends, so later commands are lost
expect: ...and the command after the here-document is still read

name: Y5: quoted command words keep their quotes
expect: Y5: a quoted command word is still the word (`"gh" pr merge`)
